constraint_candidates.implementation_freedom: grouping or equivalent sparse aggregation allowed
constraint_candidates.semantics: for every target t, sum_{e in E: target[e]=t} x[e] <= 1

constraint_candidates.implementation_freedom: interval sweeps or sparse time buckets allowed; unweighted count is forbidden
constraint_candidates.semantics: for each sensor s and public time step tau, sum over selected engagements active at sensor s and time tau of target_channel_need[target[e]] * x[e] <= sensor_channel_capacity[s]
for each weapon_vehicle w, sum_{e in E: weapon_vehicle[e]=w} x[e] <= weapon_inventory[w]

constraint_candidates.implementation_freedom: compact sliding-window or hit-step buckets; all-pairs only if pre-solve estimate stays within configured envelope
constraint_candidates.semantics: two selected engagements using the same weapon_vehicle conflict when abs(hit_step_i - hit_step_j) < weapon_min_launch_interval_steps[w]; equal hit_step conflicts must not be excluded; current materialization uses hit_step proxy, not true launch_step

forbidden_data_boundaries: public_instance_data.target_trace and other described_but_not_materialized trajectory/position/velocity arrays

coder_forbidden_field_names: sensor_pos, weapon_pos, target_start_pos, target_end_pos, target_speed, weapon_speed, sensor_field_of_view_deg, sensor_normal_deg, sensor_radius, weapon_radius, target_path_length, target_trace_length
any reference solution, answer key, hidden model, or trusted builder artifact

model_scope_assessment.assessment_note: PUBLIC_MODEL_SCOPE_DRAFT floor suggested trajectory_kinematic, but the executable data manifest shows trajectory/position/velocity fields are described_but_not_materialized and are coder_forbidden. BENCHMARK_EXECUTION_CONTRACT also forbids reconstructing hidden launch-time or trajectory variables. Therefore the actual supported level is sparse time-indexed assignment over authoritative public compatible_engagements.
builder_directives: Implement only the Planner-approved modeling level: time_indexed_sparse_public_candidate_assignment.
Use sparse public candidate variables x[e] over derived_public_facts.temporal_action_space.compatible_engagements.
Do not introduce independent launch_time or launch_step decision variables.
Do not construct trajectory or kinematic constraints from non-materialized fields.
Use weighted time-indexed sensor capacity constraints with target_channel_need.
Use compact sliding-window or bucketed weapon_min_launch_interval constraints; avoid all-pairs O(|E|^2).
Preserve the solver objective contract and registry metadata for replay.
Do not re-filter authoritative compatible_engagements outside permitted_filters.
